rendered: Water has the strongest hydrogen bonding of the solvents the paper compares. Its hydrogen-bonding parameter δH is 42.3 MPa^1/2[1], as plotted in the figure comparing diethylene glycol, EG, glycerol and water. The paper does not use water for delamination because water is not[2] suitable for delamination because the aluminum foil exhibited[3] corrosion due to lithium leaching from the NMC cathode,[4] making the water solution basic[5]. The corrosion of the aluminum would then contaminate the NMC particles by forming Al[6] (OH)3 precipitates on the cathode surfaces.[7]
